name: Nichiren
role: Japanese Buddhist monk and philosopher and True Buddha
contribution: A Japanese Buddhist monk and philosopher of the Kamakura period.

checks.lead: Nichiren (日蓮; Japanese pronunciation: [ɲi.tɕiꜜ.ɾeɴ, ɲiꜜ.tɕi.ɾeɴ], 16 February 1222 – 13 October 1282) was a Japanese Buddhist monk and philosopher of the Kamakura period. His teachings form the basis of Nichiren Buddhism, a unique branch of Japanese Mahayana Buddhism based on the Lotus Sutra.
